request.input:
1.2::miv4t::, 0.8::quasarcake::

anime illustration, delicate colored linework, painterly shading, layered composition. Expressive hair strands and flowing fabric contours; detailed clothing structures over economical color planes. Clear anime eyes, subtle facial shading, matte materials. Cool neutral midtones with selective vivid accents; fluid rhythms and varied edge detail. Faces and gestures anchor the composition. no text.

no humans, a single original sci-fi scavenger supply chest design. compact olive canvas supply box, charcoal reinforced corners, single brass clasp, worn utilitarian design, warm amber light. Six consecutive animation keyframes of exactly the SAME chest opening, identical camera and body shape. Frame 1 fully closed. Frame 2 closed with glowing latch. Frame 3 lid barely cracked, thin light escaping. Frame 4 lid raised halfway, intense light inside. Frame 5 lid fully open, luminous treasure energy erupting upward. Frame 6 fully open, glowing interior with suspended motes. No empty dark interior.

Game animation sprite sheet, six equal separate cells in an exact 3 columns by 2 rows grid, row-major sequence.

Fixed three-quarter view from slightly above, front and right side visible, hinge at back. Each whole chest centered in its own cell with identical floor baseline, generous margin. All six boxes equal scale. Isolated on uniform dark neutral backdrop, no scene, no labels or grid lines.

Hand-drawn anime prop illustration, substantial clear shapes, matte painted surfaces, selective colored outlines. The chest is the focus. Concentrated luminous interior, dark body still readable, controlled small highlights.
